definitions.explanation: A delivery or shipping service scheduled for the afternoon time slot. Used in logistics and postal contexts.
A flight or transportation service departing in the afternoon.

examples.japanese: {午後便|ごごびん}で{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: It will arrive by afternoon delivery.

examples.japanese: {午前便|ごぜんびん}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}わなかったので、{午後便|ごごびん}になった。
examples.english: I missed the morning delivery, so it became an afternoon one.

examples.japanese: {午後便|ごごびん}の{配達|はいたつ}は{十四時|じゅうよじ}から{十八時|じゅうはちじ}の{間|あいだ}です。
{午後便|ごごびん}の{飛行機|ひこうき}を{予約|よやく}した。
{午後便|ごごびん}なら{朝|あさ}ゆっくりできる。
examples.english: With an afternoon flight, I can take my time in the morning.

examples.japanese: {午後便|ごごびん}は{午前便|ごぜんびん}より{空席|くうせき}が{多|おお}いことがある。
examples.english: Afternoon flights sometimes have more empty seats than morning flights.

notes:
A compound of {午後|ごご} (afternoon) + {便|びん} (service, flight, delivery). The word {便|びん} is versatile, referring to both transportation services and delivery runs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {午後便|ごごびん}で{届|とど}ける: to deliver by afternoon service
- {午後便|ごごびん}を{指定|してい}する: to specify afternoon delivery
- {午後便|ごごびん}に{変更|へんこう}する: to change to an afternoon service

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {午前便|ごぜんびん}: morning delivery/flight — the morning counterpart
- {夜間便|やかんびん}: night service — delivery or flight during nighttime hours
- {時間指定便|じかんしていびん}: time-specified delivery — delivery within a requested time window
